description: This file defines the DebugControllerDispatcher class, which manages event listeners and methods for debugging control within the Playwright core server. It handles events like state changes, inspect requests, source updates, pause, and mode setting, and provides methods to initialize, set report states, highlight, resume, and kill the debug controller.

classes.name: DebugControllerDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class that manages debugging events and commands for the DebugController within the Playwright server.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the dispatcher with event listeners for various DebugController events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the debug controller with given parameters.

methods.name: setReportStateChanged
methods.description: Sets the report state change status in the debug controller.

methods.name: setRecorderMode
methods.description: Sets the recorder mode in the debug controller.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights a specific element or area in the debug view.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes execution in the debug controller.

methods.name: _onDispose
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and disposes of the debug object.
